H2_calibration.quote: Counsel should treat any reliance on this gap with great caution, since it is also an obvious fix for sponsors.

H1_holdback.quote: Raising loopholes publicly before markup may prompt a further manager's amendment that closes them. Counsel may want to separate points we raise as unworkability or drafting problems (#5–7, #11, #23–26, #29–35) from points we hold in reserve.
